scope: Released AoA 3.7.1 / Minecraft 1.20.1 static consumption-path observations, not native gameplay tests

notes.aoa3:dart_gun: Special consumption path: accepts the Forge SEEDS item tag, not only Wheat Seeds. Requests 1 + Greed level; exact tag contents depend on the pack.
notes.aoa3:gardener: Special consumption path: accepts the Forge SEEDS item tag, not only Wheat Seeds. Requests 1 + Greed level; exact tag contents depend on the pack.
notes.aoa3:sublimus: Daylight exemption: the matching inventory check still runs, but server-side spending is disabled when it is day and the shooter can see the sky. Creative rules also apply.
notes.aoa3:shoe_flinger: Equipment warning: the shared lookup also checks armor slots. Its comparison does not compare full item metadata. Keep valuable Leather Boots protected until native inventory tests pass.

named_source_limit: Newer source is used only to identify matching symbols; released bytecode separately inspected. No claim of whole-file equivalence.
